conserved.scope: Differences of saved Q5 conservative polynomials at matching Cartesian cells. GL6 integrates their squared differences and conservative integrals exactly up to FP64 roundoff on affine geometry. Linf is the maximum over GL points, not a continuous polynomial supremum. Derived pressure/speed norms and integrals are quadrature estimates. No analytic Sedov-error, between-frame, or positivity-everywhere claim.
conserved.normalization: Per component: L2=||candidate-reference||_L2/||reference||_L2; Linf=max_GL|candidate-reference|/max_GL|reference|. Zero reference denominator gives zero for zero difference, otherwise JSON null. Signed conservative integral differences integrate candidate-reference directly; the GL L1 denominator avoids cancellation in near-zero total momentum.

sigma.alpha_provenance: caller-supplied physical alpha assertions; not encoded/verified in VTU

grid.integration_measure: common Cartesian cell area after checking every saved node against that mesh

sigma.field_semantics: IGR scalar sigma, compared as its complete saved Q5 polynomial; not an Euler conserved component.

sigma.scope: Full saved Q5 sigma polynomials over every matched Cartesian cell. GL6 integrates the squared difference and scalar integrals exactly up to FP64 roundoff. Linf is sampled at GL points, not a continuous supremum. Sigma is not an Euler conserved component. No physical sigma acceptance budget, analytic accuracy, center-preview proxy or unsaved-time claim.
sigma.normalization: L2=||candidate-reference||_L2/||reference||_L2; Linf=max_GL|candidate-reference|/max_GL|reference|. Zero denominator gives zero for zero difference, otherwise JSON null.

native_gll.scope: Saved Q5 conservative polynomials sampled at each cell GLL6x6 nodes, reconstructed from validated equispaced VTK positions in FP64. Pressure=(gamma-1)*(E-|momentum|^2/(2*rho)) is evaluated only for finite conservative samples with rho>0; other samples are counted unavailable/nonfinite. Minima are over finite values. No positivity claim between nodes, at other sample sets, or at earlier times.
